purpose: Decide whether the parked VAT Posting Setup route should be reopened now that U-ITEM-HW100 visibly carries VAT Product Posting Group VAT19, without changing Business Central.
sourceEvidence: TARGET-027D24 parked the VAT Posting Setup matrix because no safe standard write route for INLAND + VAT19 was proven.
TARGET-053 selected VAT19 as the source-backed VAT Product Posting Group target value for U-ITEM-HW100.
TARGET-054 proved VAT19 visible on U-ITEM-HW100 after reopening the item card.
TARGET-054 did not prove VAT Posting Setup, VAT calculation, VAT Entries, documents, Preview Posting or Posting.

smartDecision.whyNow: TARGET-054 changed the item-side VAT product value from empty to VAT19. Before any VAT matrix write is retried, the Autopilot must decide whether this new state removes a dependency or whether the earlier matrix blocker remains unchanged.
smartDecision.risk: A visible VAT19 item value can be mistaken for VAT readiness. It is only one prerequisite and does not create a VAT Posting Setup matrix row.
smartDecision.fallback: If the evidence still shows no safe VAT matrix write route, keep VAT matrix parked and choose the General Posting Setup route decision or another read-only UI/source discovery case.

acceptanceCriteria: No Business Central or Playwright execution occurs.
Prior VAT matrix blockers are reviewed against the new TARGET-054 item-card state.
The decision clearly says reopen VAT matrix route, keep parked, or replace with a better setup route.
No VAT, General Posting Setup, item, document, Preview Posting, Posting or API action is performed.
Next-step decision reviews at least VAT matrix, General Posting Setup, O2C preflight and first Preview gate.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-054 proved WAREN and VAT19 saved on U-ITEM-HW100 after reopen; VAT Posting Setup and General Posting Setup remain unproven.
nextStepDecision.reason: The VAT route was previously parked. The new item-side VAT19 value changes the dependency picture but does not itself prove VAT setup, so a local route decision is safer than immediate setup writing.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Local evidence decision only; no BC execution required.
General Posting Setup INLAND/WAREN is still required after item Product Posting Group WAREN.
O2C remains blocked until VAT and General Posting Setup are consciously resolved or parked with a clear preflight boundary.
Preview Posting is still blocked because no document and no complete posting setup are proven.

nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It protects against treating item-card VAT19 as VAT setup truth and keeps the next action source/evidence-driven.
risksBeforeNextCase: Confusing VAT Product Posting Group on the item with VAT Posting Setup readiness.
Reopening a previously blocked matrix write route without a new route hypothesis.
Skipping General Posting Setup INLAND/WAREN before O2C/P2P preflight.
requiredPreparation: Compare VAT matrix blockers with the new item-card state.
Choose reopen, park or replacement route explicitly.
